sources.title: GitHub - mekhushi/Green-AI-Insights: Interactive dashboard analyzing AI ...
sources.snippet: Introduction Green-AI-Insights is an interactive dashboard designed to analyze the performance and carbon footprint of AI experiments. It aims to promote sustainable machine learning practices by providing insights into the environmental impact of different AI models and training techniques.
